name: Mrs Clover, Midwife
text: After you summon a unit: give it +1/+1. Twice a fight.
golden_text: After you summon a unit: give it +2/+2. Twice a fight.
details: Any tribe’s summons count, in either phase. Recruiting buffs are permanent. The two-buff limit applies in combat; a Spilled summon never entered the board and is not buffed.

source.note: Pass 2 review calls in DECISIONS.md take precedence.
